responses.reply: Step-by-step: 1) Click the '+ Daily Campaign' button. 2) Enter a clear topic/headline. 3) Choose target channels and a tone (Conversational/Educational/Storytelling). 4) Click 'Spark Daily Content Engine' to generate caption, hashtags, and visuals. 5) Review generated items, adjust if needed, then 'Approve' or 'Publish Instantly'.

Sandbox vs Live: Sandbox creates a simulated publishing preview (safe testing + fake comments). Direct Meta Live publishes to your connected Instagram Business account via the Meta Graph API (requires Page Access Token and Business/Account ID). Use Sandbox to preview, Live to publish.

Here are 5 topic ideas:
1) '3 Morning Habits of High Performers'
2) 'How Faith Shapes Creative Consistency'
3) 'Quick Productivity Rituals for Creators'
4) 'Overcoming Creative Burnout in 5 Steps'
5) 'Micro-actions That Scale Your Brand'

Graphic tips: Open 'Graphic Card Spec' → adjust background color, text color, accent color; choose layout family (sans/mono/serif) and pattern (grid/dots/waves). Press 'Regenerate Graphic Image' to produce a new visual.
